# CoBible

> CoBible is a cross-platform Bible reading and study app (English and Russian). It combines the Bible text, podcast episodes that explain each chapter, AI analysis of chapters and of single verses (Gemini AI), reading plans, streaks and optional Google Drive sync.

## Pages
- [English site](/): features, installation, FAQ
- [Русская версия](/ru): возможности, установка, вопросы

## Platforms
Available via GitHub Releases: Android APK, Windows x64 (ZIP), universal macOS for Intel and Apple Silicon (DMG), iOS IPA for iPhone and iPad installed using [Sideloadly](https://sideloadly.io/) from Windows or Mac. The site includes expandable instructions for both computer systems. A free Apple Account requires renewing the installation every 7 days. Google Play and App Store distribution is planned.
- [Latest stable release](https://github.com/antkeepapp/cobible-releases/releases/latest)
The site discovers platform files in the latest stable release automatically; versioned filenames are supported.
